props.heading: Public Records Request
props.body: The City of Fairview is committed to government transparency. Under the Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) and state open records laws, you have the right to request access to public records maintained by the city. Our team processes requests promptly and will respond within 5 business days of receipt.

props.text: How to Submit a Public Records Request
Follow the steps below to submit your request. All requests are logged and tracked for your convenience. You may check the status of your request at any time using your confirmation number.

items.heading: Identify the Records You Need
items.content: Be as specific as possible when describing the records you are requesting. Include dates, names, departments, or any other details that will help us locate the documents efficiently.

items.heading: Submit Your Request
items.content: Click the "Start New Request" button below to fill out the online request form. You may also submit requests via email at records@fairview.gov, by mail, or in person at City Hall.

items.heading: Receive Confirmation
items.content: You will receive a confirmation number and email acknowledgment within 1 business day. Use this number to track the progress of your request.

items.heading: Records Review & Processing
items.content: Our team will review your request and gather the responsive documents. Some records may require redaction of exempt information under applicable law. Complex requests may take additional time.

items.heading: Receive Your Records
items.content: Once processed, you will be notified by email or phone. Records can be provided electronically, by mail, or for in-person pickup. Fees may apply for copies exceeding 50 pages.

props.heading: Key Information
items: Response time: Within 5 business days of receipt
No fee for the first 50 pages of copies
Additional pages: $0.15 per page for standard copies
Electronic records provided at no charge when available
Expedited processing available for urgent media or legal requests
Appeals may be filed within 30 days of a denial

props.text: Start a new public records request using our secure online form. You will need to provide your contact information and a description of the records you are seeking.

items.content: City Hall, 200 Main Street, Suite 110, Fairview, ST 45678

items.title: What records can I request?
items.content: You may request any record maintained by the City of Fairview that is not exempt from disclosure under state or federal law. This includes meeting minutes, contracts, budgets, correspondence, permits, and more.

items.title: Are there any fees?
items.content: The first 50 pages of standard copies are provided at no charge. Additional pages cost $0.15 each. Electronic records are generally provided free of charge. Specialized media or certified copies may incur additional fees.

items.title: How long will it take to get my records?
items.content: We will acknowledge your request within 1 business day and provide a substantive response within 5 business days. Complex requests involving large volumes of records or legal review may require an extension of up to 10 additional business days.

items.title: Can I appeal a denial?
items.content: Yes. If your request is denied in whole or in part, you will receive a written explanation of the legal basis for the denial. You may file an appeal with the City Manager's Office within 30 calendar days of the denial.

items.title: Can I submit a request anonymously?
items.content: You are not required to state the reason for your request. However, we do need a name and contact method (email or mailing address) to deliver the responsive records to you.
